# USA Medical Supply

> > USA Medical Supply provides medical equipment, PPE, orthopedic devices, and tactical gear with government procurement capabilities across multiple U.S. states.

USA Medical Supply operates as a registered government vendor serving states including Alabama, California, Delaware, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maine, Michigan, Mississippi, Nevada, New Jersey, and North Carolina. The company offers a diverse product range from post-operative orthopedic devices to tactical equipment and personal protective equipment.
